recipe.visualDefinition: A black background featuring a central photograph of a woman in a silver jumpsuit at a gas pump, surrounded by a grid of colorful graphic emblems mimicking mid-20th-century gasoline and automotive brand logos.
coreVisualRelationships: Central photographic figure acting as the vertical axis
Grid-like arrangement of disparate geometric shapes
High-contrast relationship between vibrant primary colors and a solid black field
Typographic hierarchy within individual emblems mimicking corporate identity
coreInvariants: Geometric container shapes (ovals, diamonds, shields, triangles)
Primary color palette (red, blue, yellow, green)
Thick white or colored borders on all graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central top-middle photo of a woman, scaled small relative to the overall canvas, with a large speech-bubble-like header above her.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central gas pump photo and the large white rounded-rectangle header.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top center header, moves down to the central figure, then scans left-to-right through the grid of logo-inspired stickers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of black negative space to isolate each graphic element and prevent visual clutter.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (background) provides the canvas for all other elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (borders and text) ensures legibility against saturated colors.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red, Royal Blue, and Golden Yellow provide the 'gas station' aesthetic.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation colors with flat, non-gradient fills to mimic 1960s screen printing.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to primary and secondary bold hues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy sans-serifs, slab serifs, and occasional scripts mimicking mid-century commercial type.
letterConstructionRules: Frequent use of all-caps for primary display text
Small, wide-tracked lowercase for secondary metadata text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters integrated into shapes (e.g., 'O' as a circle)
Stretched or compressed widths to fit specific geometric containers
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix of heavy block sans-serifs with thin, wide-spaced auxiliary text and occasional italicized scripts for variety.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, industrial feel of mid-century gas logos
Provides the slab-serif look common in 60s branding

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A solid black square background. In the upper center, place a small cutout photo of a woman in a 1970s silver jumpsuit holding a gas pump nozzle. Surround her with various empty geometric shapes (shields, circles, diamonds) in flat red, blue, yellow, and green with thick white borders.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, heavy sans-serif text inside each geometric shape. Use all-caps for the main words and small, wide-spaced lowercase for secondary text. Ensure the text is centered and fits tightly within the shapes.

verificationChecks: Are all shapes isolated on a black background?
Is the central photo integrated with a speech-bubble header?
Do the colors look like flat 1960s ink?
Is the typography bold and industrial?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos (Shell, Sinclair, etc.) must be replaced with generic geometric equivalents
Original artist names and titles must be replaced with placeholder text
Specific record label logos must be removed

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp vector-like edges on shapes

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no overlapping of the geometric stickers
Check that the central photo is the only photographic element
Verify that all text is legible and centered in its container
Confirm the background is pure black (#000000)
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central vintage-style cutout photograph with a surrounding grid of 10-12 distinct geometric 'logo' containers, each using a limited primary color palette and bold, industrial typography on a solid black field.
